systemicDefects.title: Historical 1,468-Column Drop via Last-Instance Overwrite
systemicDefects.historicalArtifact: Data preparation script dropped columns by overwriting shared column names in sequential years.
systemicDefects.remediatedTruth: 724 discrete 2025 columns plus 724 discrete 2026 columns restored into discrete schemas.
systemicDefects.safeguardMandate: Process survey years as distinct non-colliding fields; verify column dimensions programmatically.

systemicDefects.title: Corrupted 2022 Negative Paddy Margin (−₹85.13 Lakh)
systemicDefects.historicalArtifact: A formula flaw computed negative paddy margins by double-subtracting labor and draft power.
systemicDefects.remediatedTruth: Raw microdata restored: positive net surplus of +₹1,58,40,719.00 across 1,329 farmers.
systemicDefects.safeguardMandate: Prohibit negative cultivation costs; enforce microdata provenance checks.

systemicDefects.title: Inflated 3.39× Income Growth Claim from Truncated Base
systemicDefects.historicalArtifact: Old presentation claimed income increased 3.39× from ₹14,554 to ₹49,328 using truncated base.
systemicDefects.remediatedTruth: True 5-year longitudinal trajectory: ₹34,555 (2022) to ₹63,918 (2026) (+84.97% mean, +142.73% median).
systemicDefects.safeguardMandate: Present authentic 5-year series with explicit sample sizes and median statistics.

systemicDefects.title: Undisclosed Bigha Conversion Factor (Assumed 0.619 Pucca)
systemicDefects.historicalArtifact: Calculations silently assumed 1 bigha = 0.619 acre without declaring local unit definitions.
systemicDefects.remediatedTruth: Declared authoritative 0.20 acre/bigha basis (5 kacha bigha = 1 acre) with full sensitivity matrix.
systemicDefects.safeguardMandate: Mandate explicit disclosure of unit conversion standards across all land and yield tables.

systemicDefects.title: Misrepresentation as 3-Wave Longitudinal Panel with Control
systemicDefects.historicalArtifact: Earlier summaries described dataset as 3-wave longitudinal panel with quasi-experimental control.
systemicDefects.remediatedTruth: Formally anchored as two-wave retrospective recall (Wave 1: 1,329 HHs, Wave 2: 1,535 HHs) without control.
systemicDefects.safeguardMandate: Label all charts as pre-post retrospective cohort analyses to maintain academic integrity.

systemicDefects.title: Spurious 'Elite 108 Farmers' Created via Name Collision
systemicDefects.historicalArtifact: Cross-table merges on names created false super-farmers with merged incomes.
systemicDefects.remediatedTruth: Individual household merges strictly enforced using unique submission IDs (_id); 81 genuine elite farmers verified.
systemicDefects.safeguardMandate: Never join survey tables on non-unique strings (names or villages); use cryptographic IDs.

systemicDefects.title: Double-Counting Spreadsheet Subtotals in Public Leverage (₹11.70 Cr)
systemicDefects.historicalArtifact: Historical reports summed subtotals and Grand Total rows, inflating leverage to ₹11.70 Crore.
systemicDefects.remediatedTruth: Audited register total is ₹7,70,98,360 across 577 genuine civil projects.
systemicDefects.safeguardMandate: Filter out total/subtotal rows prior to summing; assert row-level consistency.

debunkedMyths.originatingContext: Early training curriculum drafted in 2021 included Agniastra as an agronomic formulation.
debunkedMyths.forensicInvestigation: Zero occurrences in primary microdata or farmer practice registers. Actual adopted pest repellents: Neemastra, 10 Parani Ark, Char Chatni.
debunkedMyths.neutralizationVerdict: Purged from all reporting; verified that zero farmer claims reference Agniastra.

debunkedMyths.originatingContext: Spreadsheet formula sum included subtotal rows across 2023, 2024, and 2025 leverage registers.
debunkedMyths.forensicInvestigation: Subtotal rows double-counted ₹3.99 Crore of projects. Row-by-row audit confirms exact sum of ₹7,70,98,360.
debunkedMyths.neutralizationVerdict: Purged; all figures pegged to audited ₹7.71 Crore across 577 verified projects.

debunkedMyths.mythName: Summer Hunger Gap (Green Vegetable Scarcity in May/June)
debunkedMyths.originatingContext: Classic development literature assumes summer is a period of severe food and vegetable stress in North India.
debunkedMyths.forensicInvestigation: FASAL microdata proves May and June are the PEAK green vegetable consumption months (67.2% – 70.4%) due to riverbed cucurbits and machan trellises.
debunkedMyths.neutralizationVerdict: Inverted and highlighted as a primary empirical discovery: winter is the true green vegetable trough.
